name: NeuralAgent reports
description: Reads the problem reports sent from the NeuralAgent app and answers them (admin API, scoped key).
guide: Sign in to the admin area of your relay (for example `https://agent.neuralhub.dev/admin/`) and open **API keys**.
Create a key. Tick **Read reports** and, if the autopilot may answer, **Answer reports**. Copy the key; it is shown only once.
Paste the key below and press **Test connection**. New reports then arrive as events every few minutes.

setup.label: API key
setup.help: Starts with nak_. Created in the admin area under API keys.
